title: The WordPress plugin's inspect is read as a list of slots, so a WordPress write step writes its words and the site check reads them back
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: wordpressReading turns the plugin's {key: words} slots and imageSlots into [{key, current, type}] with pictures typed image and keeps lists, refusals and other operations as they came; readingOnPlatform and onPlatform read a WordPress inspect that way and leave Joomla untouched; a whole JA Diner WordPress write step against the plugin's real inspect shape writes its words in one apply; the closing rule's 'does not let … be emptied' is skipped as not on WordPress yet, on WordPress only.

tests: the plugin inspect is read as a list of slots, pictures typed, by the write step and the site check alike
a WordPress Diner run writes its words as plain text in one apply, and skips in words what the plugin does not take
